domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix the alphabet and measurable probability structure, the one-sided or two-sided index set, the product space and measure, and the direction and convention of the shift.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose between construction, measure preservation, ergodicity, mixing, entropy, or isomorphism-classification conclusions.

candidate_scope_not_credited.alphabet: a finite, countable, standard Borel, or otherwise source-specified measurable alphabet with a probability law
candidate_scope_not_credited.configuration_space: one-sided sequences or bi-infinite sequences equipped with the corresponding product sigma-algebra and probability measure
candidate_scope_not_credited.transformation: a source-specified left or right coordinate shift, as an endomorphism or invertible transformation
candidate_results: the shift is ergodic or mixing under stated nondegeneracy assumptions
the entropy has a specified formula
Bernoulli shifts are classified up to measure-theoretic isomorphism by entropy
